title: Building institutions and networks - Ford Foundation

facts.fact: The Ford Foundation's BUILD initiative provides grantees with five years of general operating support, combined with targeted organizational strengthening support.
facts.quote: By providing grantees with five years of general operating support, combined with targeted organizational strengthening support

facts.fact: The Ford Foundation is inviting up to 300 organizations and networks to join BUILD.
facts.quote: the Ford Foundation is inviting up to 300 organizations and networks to join BUILD

facts.fact: The Ford Foundation describes BUILD as a $1 billion initiative.
facts.quote: BUILD, a $1 billion initiative that gives them the trust, flexibility, and additional support they need to do their best work

facts.fact: The Ford Foundation states that all videos it has produced since 2020 include captions and downloadable transcripts.
facts.quote: All videos produced by the Ford Foundation since 2020 include captions and downloadable transcripts.
